slots.notes: Fixed fullscreen background video covering the viewport (object-fit:cover, transform:scale(1.35)); played as a boomerang via throttled manual currentTime seeking rather than native playback, so it must be a short seamless clip.
Small 14x14 monochrome brand/platform glyph (inline SVG path, 24x24 viewBox) rendered inside the Max CTA button before the 'Download' label; inherits the dark button text color.
Display + body typeface for the whole section; loaded via Google Fonts @import inside the style block. Native value is Inter (weights 300/400/500/600).

mechanic: A fixed fullscreen background video boomerangs via a requestAnimationFrame loop that manually steps currentTime by 0.05s every 33ms and flips direction at both ends (guarded by video.seeking, no native play), behind a centered glassmorphic two-tier pricing card overlay.
techDelivery: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript single full-viewport section, styles authored in an inline <style> block (Tailwind available but unused), Google Fonts @import for Inter.
reskinNotes: Title gradient hex (#737373 -> #ffffff) and dark body background (#050505) are baked into CSS, not driven by the color tokens. Brand glyph is a hardcoded inline SVG path (Apple logo) and the list bullet is a CSS ::before content '\2713' (Unicode check), so neither swaps with brand assets without editing markup/CSS. All copy is hardcoded in JSX. Layout is tuned for Inter's metrics. Class names are prefixed c4-.
